BiblicalUsage: The people break down the house of Baal and smash his altars and images, and Jehu breaks down the house of Baal and makes it a draught house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tearing down is part of worship: the house of Baal cannot stand beside the house of the LORD, and what I will not break down will one day demand my worship.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
